answer: Emission per identity starts as a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 18 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 311 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. A terrace of doubt is healthy, a copper of proof is required, and a anchor of patience is the price of a clean panel.
